attBesluta.text: Quality pump with quick delivery at a great price

Estou muito satisfeito com esta Top Case! A relação preço qualidade é excelente, os conteúdos são muito completos e a caixa é muito prática e cómoda, a construção é robusta, apenas os bolsos na tampa deveriam ser maiores e ter algum fecho ou molas, porque em deslocação as coisas saltam, mas aconselho vivamente!!
Attached to bike great. Best quality. helmet and many things will fit inside. very sturdy and easily removable from bike with just a locked latch. highly recommend.

Perfecta para la Zontes 125X, un pequeño problema es que no deja abrir el asiendo, facilmente solucionable desplazando el baul un poco hacia afuera, no complicado y rápido. Se entiende que llevando este baúl, poco necesitaras el hueco del asiento.

The box is good quality for the price, but I’m pretty sure the lid is plastic and not aluminum. The 55L is pretty huge and can easily hold a full face helmet and jacket. I got this size because my laptop bag will lie flat… but it’s a chonk. The mounting system is good and the hardware feels decent quality. I was able to mount it to my Vstrom 800 factory luggage shelf without any drilling or cutting. It does wobble a bit more than I would like, but it’s not at risk of falling off. I would buy again but would get the 45L to look slightly less dorky.
Muy buen producto las imágenes no hacen justicia al baúl muy buena calidad y fácil de instalar merece la pena por ese precio
Mounts nice and low, I was able to tuck my garage Vevor mini-split unit under my stairs. It has rubber feet and vibrasonic bolt to mount the unit to. I can’t feel any vibration whatsoever

This stand is being used and support my 12k but Stealth solar mini split. I give it 5 stars for easy for an easy assembly and quality. It offers adjustable lateral, height adjustments with concrete mounting hardware. No wobble and should withstand high winds.
Not a bad stand at all for the money. I bought 2 and have worked as they should.

I bought this for a 24k mini split install that used 3/8 and 5/8 copper lines. Before I bought the tool I had ruined my first 5/8 pipe trying to hand bend it, but this tool was able to give me clean 90 degree bends.
